title: Tesla updates self-driving visualization with third-person neural camera view
summary: Tesla introduced an update to its autonomous driving system that employs onboard optical cameras and neural networks to render a third-person overhead perspective on the vehicle display.
research_notes:
Activate the third-person camera perspective on the center display to monitor real-time spatial neural reconstructions of the vehicle driving path.

Ensure all exterior camera lenses remain unobstructed to maintain neural network spatial reconstruction accuracy in third-person view.
